_comment: Dev settings for playtests: each key is an independent setting, read by its own task's code. Not game balance, never shown to the player (no UI, no text; HUD and menus, Decisions). The GUT suite switches them all off (tests/pre_run_hook.gd). run_timer_start (task T-045): with enabled true, every run starts with minutes:seconds on the clock instead of 8:00, fast-forwarded as if the missing time had passed (the boss still comes at 1:00 left, minion numbers are those of that moment in a normal run); set enabled to false for a normal 8:00 run. Must be off before the MVP ships.
